findings.question: q-biology-human-body-control-movement-and-defense-0008
findings.quote: They act the same way for every germ.
findings.problem: This is a false absolute about skin and mucus barriers. For example, the acidic skin surface inhibits some bacteria while acid-tolerant microbes can survive there. A broad defense does not act identically against every germ. This also fails to explain directly why strengthening these barriers is not the vaccine mechanism being tested.
findings.fix: Replace with: "These barriers help block germs, but the protection tested here comes from memory cells. Check which defense remembers a specific target."
